remarks: Located just minutes away from Wilton Town Center, schools,train, & major highways, this private, much loved 4-bedroom, 3.5 bath Colonial offers 4200+ sqft of living space plus a finished lower-level playroom.Situated on 2 acs of flat,park-like property w/beautiful gardens & deck this gem awaits its new owners.This home offers peace,quiet & privacy plus all the benefits of living on a cul de sac w/access to the Norwalk River Valley Trail-Wilton Section, the 10.2, out and back trail is great for hiking & walking.Welcome to 30 Twin Oak Lane!Enter the front foyer & step into the light & bright dining room w/plenty of room to dine w/family and friends.The heart of the home is the eat-in kitchen w/granite counters & pellet stove which opens to the large family room w/sliders to the deck & private backyard.The spacious living room has a beautiful fireplace,built-in window seats & access to a private patio,a perfect area to entertain large groups of guests or nestle close to the wood burning fireplace.A cozy den w/built-in bookshelves & 3rd fireplace can serve as an office or first floor bedroom.1.5 baths & back staircase complete the main level.Venture upstairs to the primary BR suite & you will surely be impressed!This spacious room has a vaulted ceiling w/wood beams,fireplace,built-ins,private balcony,sitting room,walk-in closet & private bath.3 add'l bedrooms & hall bath complete the 2nd levelOther feature include a walk-up fin attic, LL playroom, HW floors, shed & 2-car garage
